Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with?

Agent: Navodaya Finance, this is Arjun speaking. How can I help?
Customer: Hello. I have a personal loan with you and I want to close it early. I got my annual bonus.
Agent: That's great. Could you share your loan account number?
Customer: It's 7700 4521.
Agent: Thank you, Ms Fernandes. The loan started fourteen months ago, and the outstanding principal is Rs 2,18,400.
Customer: What will I have to pay to close it today?
Agent: Since you've paid more than 12 EMIs, the foreclosure charge is 2% of the outstanding principal, which is Rs 4,368, plus 18% GST on that charge, Rs 786. There's also interest for the days since your last EMI, about Rs 1,950. So the total is roughly Rs 2,25,504.
Customer: Two percent? I thought there was no charge after one year.
Agent: That applies to loans taken after April last year. Your loan was sanctioned before that, so the older terms apply. I can send you the clause from your agreement.
Customer: Please do. And how do I pay?
Agent: I'll email you a foreclosure letter today. It's valid for seven days, and you can pay through net banking using the reference on the letter. Once the payment clears, we'll issue a no-dues certificate within 10 working days.
Customer: Okay. Can you also stop the auto-debit for next month?
Agent: Yes. I've put a hold on the December auto-debit, which takes effect once the foreclosure is paid.
Customer: Thank you.
Agent: You're welcome. Have a nice day.

Customer: Okay. What if it doesn't come?
Agent: If it isn't credited by Friday, please call us with the complaint number and we'll escalate it to the grievance team. You can also track it in the app under Help, UPI disputes.
Customer: Fine. Thank you.
Agent: Thank you for your patience. Have a good day.

Customer: Let me discuss it with my wife first. Can you email me both calculations?
Agent: Of course. I'll email a comparison of the two options to your registered email address today.
Customer: Okay, thanks.

संदेश: "प्रिय ग्राहक, आपके पर्सनल लोन की ₹7,850 की EMI 5 तारीख को आपके खाते से कटेगी।"
सरल हिंदी में समझाइए कि क्रेडिट स्कोर क्या होता है और इसे कैसे सुधारा जा सकता है। चार वाक्यों से ज़्यादा न लिखें।

கீழே உள்ள புகாரை billing, fraud, service ஆகியவற்றில் ஏதேனும் ஒன்றாக வகைப்படுத்துங்கள். ஆங்கிலத்தில் வகையின் பெயரை மட்டும் எழுதுங்கள்.
புகார்: "எனக்குத் தெரியாமல் என் கணக்கிலிருந்து ₹8,000 எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. நான் யாரிடமும் OTP சொல்லவில்லை."
ஒரு வாடிக்கையாளர் கேட்கிறார்: "என் வீட்டுக் கடனின் வட்டி விகிதம் ஏன் உயர்ந்தது? என் EMI-யும் அதிகமாகுமா?" வங்கியின் சார்பில் தமிழில் மூன்று வாக்கியங்களில் பணிவான பதில் எழுதுங்கள்.

অভিযোগ: "তিনবার শাখায় গিয়েও আমার পাসবুক আপডেট হয়নি, কেউ সাহায্য করছে না।"
